Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard Sri Shujat Kidwai, learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. The FIR in question was lodged as a missing person report on 22.04.2024 alleging that daughter of the informant was enticed away by the applicant on 17/18.04.2024.
In the statement under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C., the victim did not support the prosecution story and stated that they were in love and have also married.
The tentative age of the victim is around 17 years.
3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

opennyai_summary.decision:
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.
5. Let the applicant Irshad be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 0373 of 2024, under Sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Section 5J(2)(L)/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Barabanki, on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
